symptom: Arm jerks then stops The arm jerks and then stops during motion.
failure_mode: Loose encoder cable at joint J2 The encoder cable at joint J2 is loose.
failure_mode_name: Loose encoder cable at joint J2
corrective_action: Re-seat J2 encoder cable and tighten both connector screws Re-seat the J2 encoder cable and tighten the connector screws. Re-seat J2 encoder cable and tighten both connector screws.
corrective_action_name: Re-seat J2 encoder cable and tighten both connector screws

symptom: Gripper will not close The gripper will not close on command.
failure_mode: Low pneumatic pressure below 5 bar Pneumatic supply pressure is below 5 bar.
corrective_action: Restore air supply to 6 bar and repeat grip test Restore the pneumatic supply and repeat the grip test. Restore air supply to 6 bar and repeat grip test.
corrective_action_name: Restore air supply to 6 bar and repeat grip test
